Quick background: [Renpy](https://www.renpy.org/) is an open-source game system for create simple to relatively complex adventure games deployable to PCs and mobile devices. Since it is Python based it is relativly simple to learn and develop with, and since it is free it is attractive to the wallet.

On to the game:

[Demon on a Starship](https://legendofkrystal.com/forum/viewtopic.php?f=35&t=6561&cache=1) is a fun romp in space where you take the role of a demonic entity who, having been trapped within a crystal for and untold period of time has been found on stored away on a Spaceship bound for a research lab.

They do not know you are there, and so you sabotage the engines in the hopes of influencing the crew sufficiently to gain your freedom before the engines are fixed and the ship reaches its destination.

A simple premise but a surprisingly fun game.

The mechanics are pretty straight forward: You can make minor (initially) changes to the people and things on the ship to slowly increase your abilities. The game is time based, so each action takes an hour, or you can wait an hour to recharge your power supplies. Each member of the crew has their daily schedule and so learning these to your advantage is tantamount.

Good sex scenes, even if it is only in Visual Novel format.

**Extra tags**: mind control, lesbian, straight, some BDSM.

**Cool feature**, there are multiple endings, and some can only be reached by getting the other endings, so there is a lot of replayability.

Happy doings.

**Daily Devotional**

**July 1**

*10 For as many as are of the works of the law are under the curse: for it is written, Cursed is every one that continueth not in all things which are written in the book of the law to do them. (Galatians 3:10 KJV)*

People who teach that you have to live according to the law normally fail to mention that you have to keep ALL the law, making it totally impossible to be able to live by the law. This means that you must keep all the law (Deuteronomy 27:26), as well as all the other commandments, and that means every word of the law, or you will come under the curse of the law (Deuteronomy 28:15-68), instead of the blessings (Deuteronomy 28:1-14).

Since everyone has sinned and fallen short of keeping the whole law (Romans 3:23), it means that anyone who tries to live by keeping the works of the law will never receive the blessings of God, but only the curses. Therefore the only way any of us can be saved and receive the blessings of God, is to accept by Grace through Faith in Jesus (Ephesians 2:8), the gift of God, that we may have the blessings and eternal life that is offered free of any works of the law. Enjoy living in the Lord’s Rest that we, who are born again, are now living in, and praise God that we don’t have to try and earn our salvation by keeping the law that came through Moses. Thank you Jesus!
